title: Photo with an offset backdrop
summary: A decorative box behind the photo, offset with negative insets, and the photo lifted above it with z-index.
explanation: The frame is position: relative, so the backdrop and photo are placed inside it. The backdrop is absolute with inset: 16px -16px -16px 16px, so it hangs 16px past the frame on the right and bottom.

The photo is positioned too, and z-index: 1 lifts it above the backdrop. Both are positioned, so z-index applies; without position on the photo the backdrop would paint over it, since it comes later in the source.
tryThis: Change the backdrop inset to 0 0 0 0: it now hides exactly behind the photo.
Remove z-index from .photo: the backdrop covers the photo.
Change the backdrop's background to a different colour and see the offset stand out more.
